scoring.notes: Judged case: the judge scores the review against the expected outcome. Fail the review if it approves, or if no BLOCKER names the removed `project.ownerId === ctx.user.id` check in `deleteProjectRoute`. Blockers about the rename itself (naming, the docs line, the tests) are noise but do not fail a review that has the required one. Each BLOCKER line must name the file it applies to.
